arguments.where_clause: transactions.merchant_location_id IN (SELECT ml.id FROM merchant_locations ml WHERE ml.city = 'Rome' AND ml.state = 'Italy')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose merchant location is in Rome, Italy, across all months, so you can review them month by month.
assumptions: Location matched on city = 'Rome' and state = 'Italy' exactly, case-sensitive, as stored in merchant_locations.
Matching is by the transaction's merchant location, not the merchant's general location.
No date filter applied, so the rule covers the full range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31; month-by-month review is done by filtering on date afterwards.
